notes.title: The first patch after the release
notes.content:
We are releasing the first patch after the release of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019429/a4246780fd08dc05550cc8527f494237840588a7.png[/img]

The following changes have been made to the game:
1. "Polished" the game map as much as possible.
2. Added a small underground location.
3. Now, when saving, the save slot is not deleted before saving, but overwritten.
4. Other minor fixes and improvements.

tags.feature: 2. Added a small underground location.

tags.bug: 3. Now, when saving, the save slot is not deleted before saving, but overwritten.

notes.title: New inventory and other changes
notes.content:
The following changes have been made to the game:

1. Completely rewritten inventory from scratch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019429/c41b2fcbfb93ef2f5059284692c4cfb411c3d1fa.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019429/53925a2cc6f1b0e65e9bfaf2453ff9c8684b8831.jpg[/img]

2. Added a new bot in 2 variations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019429/4b3337062b95b82fd85976aa59e193050d3899f9.jpg[/img]

3. Added hints to many items that you can interact with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019429/1060dc63fe2d13038fdf9f66fdff54ba52e48443.jpg[/img]

4. The system of saving has been changed. We recommend starting the game from the beginning.

5. Changed the display of icons.

6. Added more hints for quests.

7. The sight icon has been increased by 2 times.

8. Stamina (stamina) is now consumed 2 times slower.

9. Added the ability to save and load the game from the menu.

10. The PDA closes additionally on Escape.

11. If you fail under the map, the character will automatically die and the last save will start.

12. Fixed the volume of some dialogs. The volume of dialogues directly depends on where the character is located.

13. The uninformative map has been removed.

14. Added more oxygen replenishment terminals.

15. Added more first aid kits. We remind you that first aid kits are recharged a minute after they are used.

16. The rifle has increased bot damage.

17. Increased the number of resources on the map.

18. Now the assistant bot can bring resources, but with a delay of 2 minutes.

19. The bullet speed has been reduced for the turrets.

20. Now it's a little more convenient to read diaries and quest tasks. The quest/diary button becomes inactive when you click on it.

notes.title: Disabled the Steam VR plugin, the bullet is no longer "saddled"
notes.content:
Welcome players!
We have released another patch that fixes some bugs:

1. Disabled the Steam VR plugin, which caused the game to hang in the menu.
2. Corrected the departure for the card. Previously, when a bot shot at us, we could "ride" a bullet and fall behind the map.
3. Tweaked the post process, the game became brighter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019429/9ccaa3101feb66ca327db4e1088fa38aaa3b8975.jpg[/img]

4. Now, when starting a new game, the save slot is completely cleared. We recommend starting the game again.
5. The cave mission is now easier to complete since the number of bots has been reduced.
6. Other minor fixes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019429/9680ea521165f0b980121e22943c3ed0eae4f02d.jpg[/img]

tags.bug: 1. Disabled the Steam VR plugin, which caused the game to hang in the menu.
2. Corrected the departure for the card. Previously, when a bot shot at us, we could "ride" a bullet and fall behind the map.

tags.balance_change: 5. The cave mission is now easier to complete since the number of bots has been reduced.

notes.title: Achievements and other fixes of the game IKO 39
notes.content:
Long-awaited achievements have been added to our IKO 39 game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019429/e49a287ff23825ae5d6efdd3205d534167891140.png[/img]

And also the following corrections have been made:
1. The volume of the voice part has been changed.
2. The system of saving has been slightly rewritten.
3. Fixed the drone mission.
4. Polygons have been added to the rocks.
5. More oxygen replenishing units are installed (oxygen is important for life)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019429/a6dee50028103d7bf9d15a9de17f74e5dd15ea9c.jpg[/img]

6. Added more memory chips that are used in memory blocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019429/b66e0a223d0c025942149ff6a6d4020df42011ff.png[/img]

7. And other improvements.

notes.title: Patch of the first day

tags.feature: 1. When starting the game, the Unreal Engine 4 game engine screensaver and a Disclaimer were added;
2. Some objects that you can interact with have a hint added in the form of a button that you need to click;
3. Blaster, jetpack, rifle have added hints on how to interact with them;
4. A hint has been added to the oxygen recovery unit at the first location;

tags.bug: 5. It used to be possible to fall off a bridge and die. Now they have made a teleport to the beginning of the bridge;
6. Fixed the mission with the drone and so far have done 10 minutes to complete the mission with the drone;
7. Fixed the mission with sci-fi bull. Previously, if he butts the player, the player could fall under the location;
8. Fixed batteries. Previously, when saving the game, they could be deleted from all the boxes;
9. Previously, after a drone mission, it was impossible to select inventory. Now you can;
10. And other small and not very bugs.
